restriction_counts.scope: Exact Hilbert functions and bound arithmetic; not uniform generic projection for every subvariety.

rational_faces.scope: Shared-face incidence and strict-budget examples; not an algorithm for every rational polytope family.

cylinder_certificate.scope: Exact source cylinder identities and inverse; no non-polynomiality or rigidity verification.

filtered_derivations.scope: Weighted polynomial models with positive and negative degrees; no source associated-graded presentation.

trace_pairing.scope: Local perfect-pairing algebra; no source curve or principal-parts construction.

jet_brackets.scope: Exact local vector-field algebra; no convergence or global obstruction vanishing.

logarithmic_curvature.scope: Polynomial Levi identities and diffuse-plus-atomic mass models; no nonsmooth compactness theorem.

invariant_measure_obstruction.scope: Exact matrix and finite partition data; infinite-measure exclusion is the written countable-additivity argument.

limitations: Checks concern selected finite mechanisms, not Fujita freeness, cancellation failure, Lipman-Zariski or Griffiths counterexamples.
